svg.aria-label: Tools. Apple platforms: Swift, Apple, SwiftUI, UIKit, ARKit, RealityKit, Metal, SpriteKit, AVFoundation, Speech, Vision, Core Motion, Combine, TipKit. Languages: Python, C, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, R, Dart, PHP. Machine learning: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn. Web and back end: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, Django, FastAPI, Laravel, MongoDB, MySQL. Apps, games, hardware: Flutter, Unity, Arduino. Workflow: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Figma
